This project proposes an exploration of the conceptions of the water cycle and the environment preserved in Arabic sources composed from the twelfth century onwards, during the period commonly defined as post-classical. Although hydraulic engineering in the Arab-Islamic context has been the subject of numerous studies, a history of hydrological thought remains to be written for the centuries following the twelfth. item.description:

Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GLOT-01 Glottologia e linguistica

The research concerns the design, methodological coordination, and psychometric and statistical validation of tools for the assessment and certification of proficiency in Italian Sign Language (LIS). The activities will include defining the validation design, overseeing data collection and quality-control procedures, and applying psychometric methods and advanced statistical models to analyse reliability, validity, internal consistency, and item quality. They will also include the development of standardised protocols, technical and scientific reports, and operational recommendations to ensure fairness, accuracy, and comparability in the measurement of language proficiency.
